mina: quick note from mosaic bring-up on canary — small multilingual eval shows detok jitter for CJK+latin-number lines when kvcache chunking and batching are enabled. chrF down ~2.4 on our devset.
siddharth: ouch. any repro example? tokenization or model output change?
mina: minimal repro: input: "莫尔西 2024 Q1 报告 (summary)"
mina: baseline detok: 莫尔西 2024 Q1 报告 (summary)
mina: mosaic-qint4+kvcache detok: 莫尔西 2024 Q1  报告 ( summary )  <-- extra space before CJK token and spaces around parens
siddharth: can you paste token ids before/after?
mina: baseline ids slice: [2101, 8802, 90077, 60, 301]
mina: qint4+kvcache ids: [2101, 8802, 900, 77, 60, 301]  // split 900 -> 77 introduces space
mina: split only shows up when batch_size>1 AND kvcache.chunk_size>=64; single-example path matches baseline.
eval-bot: running targeted suite: 700 mixed-cjk-numeric samples; BLEU delta = -2.1; numeric subgroup delta = -5.5
siddharth: sounds like token boundary jitter from batching normalization ordering or a serializer bug when packing batched token streams. Any tokenizer or lib bumps in the model bundle?
mina: tokenizers pinned. We recently refactored normalize_after_batch in preproc (PR 4280) to reduce CPU time. Suspect normalization moved after concat, which yields different merges on the batched string.
mina: quick local check: ```
# repro tokenize difference
python - <<'PY'
from preproc import tokenize_batch
s = '莫尔西 2024 Q1 报告 (summary)'
print('batched tokens:', tokenize_batch([s,s], normalize_after_batch=True))
print('per-example tokens:', tokenize_batch([s,s], normalize_after_batch=False))
PY
```
mina: batched path shows split, per-example preserves merged token.

infra: infra note: canary runtime using kernel-set "kvstream-fast" for qint4 as of build 2025-04-12. Logging kernel selection for the failing runs.
siddharth: bisect plan: 1) baseline weights + new preproc 2) qint4 weights + old preproc 3) qint4 + revert kernel-set. Helps isolate preproc vs quant vs kernel serializer.
mina: launching 1 & 3 now. tagging @infra for kernel audit and @devexp for onboarding caveat. :eyes:
eval-bot: re-run of 700-sample suite after reverting normalization order: BLEU delta now -0.2, numeric subgroup delta -0.4
siddharth: great — looks like normalization ordering was the root cause. Add a regression test for CJK+digits+paren under batching and gate the refactor in CI.
mina: filing PR to revert and add tests; will follow up with links to failing inputs and logs.
